summary: Top-k sampling cutoff: the model samples only from the k most likely next tokens. Same purpose as top_p, expressed as a count rather than a probability mass, and retired on the same schedule.
combines: Not supported on Claude 4.7 and later, so Opus 5, Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 in this group reject a non-default value with a 400. Unlike top_p there is no backwards-compatible value that still passes.
Still works on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6.
temperature, top_p and top_k were removed together; inferenceCapabilities.supportsTemperature already tracks which models are affected.
The Python SDK v1.0 removed the parameter from its Messages methods outright.
